returnExchange.title: Return & Exchange Policy
returnExchange.text: At Georiana, your satisfaction matters to us. This policy has been prepared in line with Egyptian Consumer Protection Law No. 181 of 2018 and its executive regulations, as well as the Consumer Protection Agency's rules for distance selling (e-commerce).
returnExchange.section1Text1: Customers may return a product within 14 days of receiving it, without giving a reason, in line with the legal right of withdrawal for distance-selling contracts.
returnExchange.section1Text2: The 14-day period starts from the actual date of delivery, not the date of purchase.
returnExchange.section2Title: 2. Conditions for Accepting a Return or Exchange
returnExchange.section2Intro: For us to accept a return or exchange request, the product must be:
returnExchange.section2Condition1: In its original condition, unused and unwashed.
returnExchange.section2Condition2: In its original packaging with all accessories included.
returnExchange.section2Condition3: Free of damage caused by customer misuse.
returnExchange.section2Condition4: Accompanied by the purchase invoice or proof of order.
returnExchange.section3Intro: If a customer receives a product that is:
returnExchange.section3Case2: Or different from what was ordered (a shipping error),
returnExchange.section3Text: the store will bear the full return or exchange shipping cost. This is a core customer right and remains valid even if the packaging has been opened.
returnExchange.section3Note: Please report any defect or error within 48 hours of delivery, along with photos of the product.
returnExchange.section4Row1Party: Product defect or a mistake by the store
returnExchange.section5Title: 5. How to Request a Return or Exchange
returnExchange.section5Step1: Contact us by phone/WhatsApp: +20 109 696 3387 or email: support@georiana.com with your order number within the specified period.
returnExchange.section5Step2: We will confirm your request and send return shipping instructions (or arrange a pickup from your address, depending on store policy).
returnExchange.section5Step3: Once the product is inspected and confirmed to meet the conditions, the return or exchange will be processed within a maximum of 2 business days.
returnExchange.section6Text1: Refunds are issued using the same payment method the customer used (bank transfer, e-wallet, credit card), within a maximum of 14 business days from the date the returned product is received and confirmed to meet the conditions.
returnExchange.section6Text2: For Cash on Delivery (COD) orders, refunds are issued via bank transfer or an e-wallet specified by the customer.
returnExchange.section6Text3: No additional fees are deducted from the refund amount unless shipping cost is payable by the customer as described in Section 4.
returnExchange.section7Text1: Products may be exchanged for a different size or color (subject to availability) within the same 14-day period and under the same conditions outlined above.
returnExchange.section7Text2: If the requested alternative is unavailable, we will contact the customer to choose another option or process a refund.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.intro: At GEORIANA, sustainability isn't an afterthought — it's part of how we design.
sustainability.fabricsText: We choose premium natural fabrics because we believe caring for the planet begins with what we put on our bodies. Selected collections incorporate recycled materials, giving existing resources a new purpose through considered design.
sustainability.craftText: We create fewer, better pieces — designed with timeless silhouettes rather than fleeting trends, so they're worn for years, not seasons.
sustainability.handmadeText: Many of our pieces are finished with delicate hand embroidery, a slower, more deliberate process that values craftsmanship over mass production.
sustainability.commitmentText: Sustainability is a continuous journey. We're always looking for better materials, better processes, and better ways to reduce our footprint — while never compromising on quality or comfort.

ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.p1: GEORIANA was created with a simple belief: everybody deserves to feel beautiful, comfortable, and confident.
ourStory.p2: We don't believe you have to fit your clothes — your clothes should fit you.
ourStory.p3: Our collections are thoughtfully designed for different body shapes, with timeless silhouettes that celebrate individuality rather than trends.
ourStory.p4: We choose premium natural fabrics because we believe caring for your body begins with what you wear. Quality, comfort, and craftsmanship guide every decision we make.
ourStory.p5: Many of our pieces are finished with delicate hand embroidery, while selected collections incorporate recycled materials, giving existing resources a new purpose through thoughtful design.
ourStory.p6: At GEORIANA, we create fewer, better pieces made to be loved, worn, and kept.
ourStory.tagline: Timeless by design. Crafted with purpose.
